|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E2 (version 3 of 4) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Supreme Leader Snoke (Holo AI) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V9-D-supremeleadersnoke_ai-2022-12-12.png]]). Each version below is a published PC card image or errata-sheet slip; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V9-D-supremeleadersnoke_ai-2022-12-12-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V9-D-supremeleadersnoke_ai-2022-01-15.gif]], 15 January 2022) → [[File:V9-D-supremeleadersnoke_ai-2022-12-12-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V9-D-supremeleadersnoke_ai-2022-12-12.png]], 12 December 2022).
* '''Original''' ([[Supreme Leader Snoke (Holo AI)]]): PC high-resolution card image uploaded 10 August 2021<ref name="img-altpng-25e5dad-supremeleadersnokeaipng">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/hires/supremeleadersnoke_ai.png</code> (high-resolution image) in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/25e5dad5826a9bb8e047c10fe325460bda7a7edc commit 25e5dad] (10 August 2021) (“Virtual AI pack series 2”). No card-size GIF of this image was committed (the card-size image <code>large/…</code> was never made from it); the PC served this PNG at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/hires/supremeleadersnoke_ai.png until it was replaced (today's copy is the latest version only), and GEMP showed the high-resolution image.</ref>. The earliest published image of this card: it was only ever committed as a high-resolution PNG, so version lists built from the card-size images missed it (ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Dark Strike”; no “(AI)” label. Text: “If you just initiated a battle where all your ability is provided by First Order characters and/or [First Order] starships, opponent loses 1 Force. If just lost, Kylo is power +3 until end of your next turn. Immune to attrition < 8 (< 4 if with Kylo).”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Supreme Leader Snoke (Holo AI) (Errata)]]): '''What changed''' (compared with the previous version, the high-resolution image of 10 August 2021): re-made for the PC's January 2022 Alternate Image update: the copyright line “Artwork not affiliated or endorsed by Lucasfilm Ltd.” → “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.”, and the art credit, icons and text box were redrawn or moved; the label “(AI)” now prints.
